concerns.text: FR-001 (Download subset, N>=500) and SC-001 (Dataset size >= 500) are not covered by a dedicated execution task. T012a handles ingestion but lacks an explicit step to 'Execute' the ingestion script to generate the artifact. T012b validates size but assumes the file exists. A task to actually run the ingestion pipeline (e.,g., 'Execute code/ingestion.py') is missing.

FR-003 (Train RF, 5-fold CV) and SC-002 (Statistical distinguishability) lack an explicit execution task. T021 describes the logic ('Train, Perform CV, T-test') but does not include a step to 'Execute code/train.py' to generate the model and metrics. The plan assumes artifacts exist without a task to create them.

FR-004 (Permutation Importance) and SC-004 (Top-2 feature p<0.05) are described in T028 but lack an explicit 'Execute' task. T028 defines the calculation logic but does not include a step to run the script to generate `feature_importance.json`.

FR-005 (Sensitivity Analysis) and SC-003 (Threshold stability) are described in T031 but lack an explicit 'Execute' task. T031 defines the sweep logic but does not include a step to run the script to generate `sensitivity_report.csv`.

FR-006 (Associational Framing) is addressed in T055 (Update template) and T074 (Generate report), but there is no explicit task to 'Execute code/generate_report.py' to produce the final `REPORT.md` artifact. T061e mentions it but is marked as a test, not a production execution.

Plan Phase 1 (Data Modeling & Contracts) requires creating `data-model.md` and `contracts/*.schema.yaml`. While T006 and T007 create the schema files, there is no task to create the `data-model.md` document itself, which is a required plan element.
Plan Phase 0 (Research & Data Strategy) requires creating `research.md`. No task exists to create or populate `research.md`.

T082-T086 are marked `[ ]` (incomplete) but reference artifacts (e.,g., `cv_folds_indices.json`, `feature_importance.json`) that are not generated by any preceding completed task. These tasks cannot be executed until the upstream generation tasks (T021, T028, T031) are completed and executed.
